title: aerf-spec/agentmint-python: Evidence Layer for AI Agent Actions (AERF v0.1)

title: Securing MCP: A Control Plane for Agent Tool Execution - Microsoft for Developers
snippet: Microsoft introduces the open-source Agent Governance Toolkit (AGT), a runtime governance layer for MCP tool execution. AGT evaluates an action before execution, adds identity and policy context, records the decision, and can route risky work for approval. Prompt-only safety instructions showed a 26.67% policy violation rate in red-team evaluation.

title: per-agent tool authorization in multi-server routing? · Issue #1835 · mcp-use/mcp-use
